content: Shawulu ɗǝ bǝtlkal ki tlo' istipanus. Agasisi, i bal bǝna mbi Ikilisiya ki Ulshelima mus is dla'ga tyage' atl ki Yahudiya nǝ Samaliya, sai milshikǝn kǝn katl.
I mi'bǝtl Lya kalen gu Istipanus is kuli gawasi.
Amma i Shawulu go' pǝli' Ikilisiya bezǝn pǝlti. A ti bǝtl libi libi, ti dǝdl mwani nǝ mudli a ti la'tisi ge'lu kǝndǝ' mbalǝn.
A dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya a Samaliya i
Ginǝs dlakisi gayi is go' dlib shilǝn ki Lya mus lu unǝs lǝɗa u.
I Pilibus su ge' gatl ki Samaliya ti dlǝb shilǝn ki Almasihu.
Nǝ hwu' mbalǝn kumi is yen gagashintu nǝ Pilibus ɗǝ pǝlti u, i mus sǝpǝ ɗemɗem nǝ ulnǝ' dlǝmi u
Nǝ la'ti Yal i du mi'gatli pe' ɗǝge' mbalǝn diɓǝli, mi'tle ki dli ne' dakkǝlsi diɓǝli is mbi ndo'ti
I hwoltu' pǝldli bali a ge' gatli.
Saminu mul Yal lu
Mulǝnɗa mulshin Saminu, teɗi ti pǝtl gonti age' gatli, hal ɗǝ bǝtl mus mbalǝn ki Samaliyawa gagashinti. Ti ɗagagga ti usu ti bal mbalǝn kǝni,
Mus mbalǝn, bazi ni mil, is gakki' kǝm asi usu, “Mulu ɗǝ mbettiki dǝtl ki Lya mul nalti.”
Si bǝlti kal tǝngaki ta lǝndǝp ɗǝ pǝlisi gagashiti nǝ pǝltl gontwasu i.
Amma nǝs la'mbatl nǝ dlǝb shilǝn ki gu' ki Lya nǝ shin ki Yesu ki Pilibus, i pǝlisi baptisma mudli nǝ mwani.
Saminu gawasi illa' badli i pǝli' baptisma. Iki ibbǝl Pilibus kali, i' kup ɓanti nǝ ye' bal ulki gagashintu.
Nǝ milshikǝn ki Ulshelima kumi mi' Samaliya a ndǝ'nǝ shilǝn ki Lya u, is shin Bitlus nǝ Yahaya tya Samaliya.
Nǝs mbǝkǝci u, is shilǝn nǝ Lya gaki mi'pyal bǝtl Yesu kal gaki sǝmmbi Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ɗa,
Gaki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya a mbi gon wasǝn uwai; a pǝlisi baptisma i katl ge'shinki Yesu.
I Bitlus nǝ Yahaya zǝsi toh, is mbi Yal ki mbatl ki Lya.
Nǝ Saminu eni zǝttoh ki milshinkǝn ɗǝ bǝtl Yal ki mbatl ki Lya u, ibbǝlsi ulpi.
I' usu, “Amima bǝlǝnnǝn manti u gaki mus mulnǝ a zǝttoh u ammbi Yal mbatl ki Lya ɗa.”
I Bitlus ndǝgi i' usu: “Mǝshnǝ ulpwagi, gaki ki enti kǝn ma'ultl bǝlti ki Lya nǝ ulpa!
Ulǝn a lakki nǝ uluwai, gaki mbadlwa'ɗa nǝm akina ɗǝ Lya wai.
Gaki nǝgu za'pǝtl bezǝn lǝɓa a' ngem Lya ɗǝgon a' okǝlki ɗǝ ge' ulnǝ' ngapi ge' mbadlwa gu.
Gaki a eni i ka njikǝn nǝ ɗashti nǝ ngapti bezǝn lǝɓa i.”
I Saminu ndǝgi, “Ngemǝn Lya gayini gaki ulnǝ' dlimini u ɓa ndanǝ ami.”
Kalkǝ dlib shilǝn ki Lya wasǝn nǝ ndǝ'twasǝn nǝ Yesu, Bitlus nǝ Yahaya is paltya Ulshelima, si dlib shilǝn ki Lya ge' mil gatl ki Samaliya dǝɓili.
Pilibus isǝ mul Habasha
I mul shinkǝn ki Lya ul Pilibus su, “Lǝ tu'tǝn tona ki shitu dǝlgǝn gunǝ pe'te' Ulshelima ɗǝlǝ Gaza u.”
I' hilya ippeki, tǝn shitu wasi imma isǝ mul Habasha Ndami bal mbalǝn mul nalti, gu' ni'ɗa ge' gu' ki Kandakatu, tikǝ mul zi' lǝɓa (Kǝ “Salauniya ki Habasha”). Muli mbǝ Ulshelima ɗǝ ngep Lya,
Ti patl tya libi tiki dǝmi ge' Bǝsdomwasi, ti dlib lashti kǝge' lwabbat ki Ishaya.
I Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ul Pilibus su, “Sha'tya ma' Bǝsdomu.”
I Pilibus kitǝl tyage' Bǝsdomi, i' kum muli ɗǝ dlib lashti kǝge' lwabbat ki Ishaya. “Kimanǝn ulnǝ ki dlimti ge' lashti uwa?” Pilibus usu.
“A mani una,” i' usu, “Ai se nǝ mulǝn adlimini.” Immbe Pilibus bi sǝddǝm siti.
Gukǝ shilǝn ki Lya unǝ ti dlimti u: “A dǝlti kǝnǝ mbila ge' lu poshtiti, kǝnǝ kan unǝ bǝgǝmdla ɗa atoh ɗǝ mul swattiti u, nǝgu ta ɓulbiwai.
A ge' shidǝtlgawasi is nge bǝtlti baliwasi. Wokǝn matl dlib gǝs ki mbalǝnwasi? Akan dliwas taka ɗǝtǝn dǝb lǝɓa i.”
I bali i ngem Pilibus, “Dlimini, mul nje'shinkǝn ki Lya u, shilǝn ki o ti dlimti, gwasa ko ki mulǝn?”
I pilibus gob dlib shilǝn ki Lya itl dlimi' shilǝn ki Yesu.
Si ge' lǝti is mbǝkǝci ma' bal malon i bali i usu, “Ya mal kǝn ngu. Ya la'tiɗa bǝ kǝkkǝn pǝlitǝn baptisma wai?”
I pilibus usu, inka la'mbatlu, nǝ mbatl nǝm mu, nǝn pǝliki batisma.” I bali i ndǝgiti i' usu, “A ndǝgi Yesu yakǝn ki Lya kǝni.”
Ibbǝl zhil tǝ dlil bǝsdomi. Ndǝn wasǝn Pilibus isǝ Bali i is suge' mali i Pilibus pǝli' baptima.
Nǝs pe'todɗǝ ge' mali u, i Yal ki mbatl ki Lya kan Pilibus, Bali i a yenti nuwai. Izzǝga ati pǝtl hwoltugi.
Ngonǝnǝ gu i Pilibus lǝ' mbi gawasi a Azontus. Ibbǝl gatl tyai, a ti dlib shilǝn ki Lya mus ge' gatli hal immbǝcci Kaisaliya ɗa.
